data.one_liner: Background location tracking for Android and iOS using background_locator_2
data.what_it_does: Provides continuous location updates even when the app is in the background. It is a thin wrapper around the background_locator_2 plugin, exposing a simple API for configuring intervals, distance filters, and notifications.
use_when: Need persistent location updates in background
Building health or fitness tracking apps
When the app must keep running after being killed by the OS
avoid_when: When you prefer to handle permissions and location logic yourself
strengths: Works in background on both Android and iOS
weaknesses: Requires manual permission setup on Android 11+
Relies on background_locator_2 which may have its own limitations
data.setup_notes: Add Android permissions (INTERNET, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION, WAKE_LOCK, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED) and receiver/service entries. Add iOS Info.plist keys (NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription, NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription, NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription, UIBackgroundModes). Override AppDelegate.swift to register the plugin. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: background_locator_2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Directly use the underlying plugin if you need more control over its API
